pictures.scene: Johannes Vermeer, The Guitar Player — the girl playing her strings and smiling toward the light falling on her, for the choirmaster with stringed instruments a Psalm a song, may God be gracious to us and bless us
pictures.name: pd_vermeer_the_guitar_player

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, A Seaport at Sunrise — the sun standing low over the harbor and the whole water running with its light, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
pictures.name: pd_claude_lorrain_seaport_at_sunrise

pictures.scene: Johannes Vermeer, The Geographer — the mapmaker with his dividers and his charts looking up from the lands he is setting down, that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations
pictures.name: pd_vermeer_the_geographer

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Adoration of the Mystic Lamb — the companies gathered in from every side around the Lamb on the altar, let the peoples praise You O God, let all the peoples praise You
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_adoration_of_the_lamb

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Peasant Dance — the couple swung out into the dance with the village keeping its feast behind them, let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_peasant_dance

pictures.scene: Aelbert Cuyp, Young Herdsmen with Cows — the herdsmen standing over their resting cattle under the great sky, and lead the nations of the earth, Selah
pictures.name: pd_cuyp_young_herdsmen_with_cows

pictures.scene: Albrecht Dürer, Adoration of the Trinity — every rank of people, pope and emperor and farmer alike, lifted up praising below the throne, let the peoples praise You O God, let all the peoples praise You
pictures.name: pd_durer_adoration_of_the_trinity

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Harvesters — the wheat cut and bound into sheaves and the reapers sitting down to eat in the stubble, the earth has yielded its harvest, God our God blesses us
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_harvesters

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, The Heart of the Andes — the snow mountain at the far end of the world with two travelers kneeling at the wayside cross below, God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him
pictures.name: pd_church_heart_of_the_andes

lines.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song.
May God be gracious to us and bless us,
and cause His face to shine upon us,
that Your ways may be known on earth,
Let the peoples praise You, O God;
let all the peoples praise You.
Let the nations be glad and sing for joy,
for You judge the peoples justly
and lead the nations of the earth.
Let the peoples praise You, O God;
let all the peoples praise You.
The earth has yielded its harvest;
that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
